prompt:
FOUR separate PEDESTAL sprites for a 2D side-scrolling game, in ONE horizontal row, evenly spaced, with WIDE EMPTY BLACK GAPS between them. All four the same size, all sitting on the same invisible ground line, each complete and uncropped.

PERSPECTIVE — THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT. This is a 2D side-scrolling game drawn in STRICT FLAT SIDE ELEVATION, like a technical elevation drawing or a flat cardboard cutout viewed dead-on from directly across the room at the same height.
You see ONLY the FRONT FACE of the object. Nothing else.
- The TOP of the object is a single horizontal EDGE, one line. It is NOT a visible surface. You cannot see the top of anything.
- The glowing ring inlaid in the top must therefore appear as a THIN HORIZONTAL GLOWING LINE or a short flat bar along the top edge. NEVER an ellipse, NEVER an oval, NEVER a circle seen at an angle.
- NO isometric view. NO three-quarter view. NO receding side faces. NO visible depth on the left or right. NO vanishing points. NO foreshortening. NO cast perspective of any kind.
- The silhouette is a flat symmetrical shape: a trapezoid or a stack of rectangles, wider at the base, seen straight on.
If you can see the top surface of the plinth, the drawing is WRONG.

THE OBJECT: a weathered stone shrine plinth fused with cyberpunk server hardware — an altar that is also a machine. Seen flat from the front: a symmetrical stepped trapezoid, wider at the base, grey #4A5568 stone with dark seams, chipped corners and weathering streaks. A small red torii-shaped bracket is mounted flat on its front face. Thin cables run down from its base and pool on the ground. A narrow dark inset panel on the front face holds a few tiny status lights.

THE FOUR STATES, left to right:
1. IDLE — the horizontal light bar along its top edge is DIM cyan #35C6F4. Status lights dark.
2. ACTIVE — the top edge bar blazes bright cyan #8FE8FF, light spills upward from it in a narrow vertical shaft, small green #C6F02A spirit motes rise, status lights lit cyan.
3. SPENT — dead and dark. The top edge bar is unlit and visibly CRACKED, a thin wisp of grey smoke rises, cables hang slack, status lights out.
4. TALLER VARIANT — the same flat front-on design but a two-tier stepped plinth, taller, with a small stone fox-spirit statue standing on top in profile facing right, and its top edge bar lit cyan.

PIXEL ART: chunky visible square pixels on a strict grid, hard aliased edges, a 1-pixel dark outline, flat cel shading, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur.

BACKGROUND: PURE BLACK #000000 everywhere. NO grid lines, NO borders, NO ground line, NO labels, NO text, NO watermark.

PALETTE: #000000 #0A0E1F #1E33D9 #2B6FE8 #35C6F4 #8FE8FF #B026FF #FF2D95 #FF6B1A #FFD400 #8F1116 #E01F26 #C6F02A #6B8A0F #FFFFFF #4A5568.
